description: This is a unit test class for the Employees module in SuiteCRM, testing various methods of the Employee class including creation, data validation, retrieval, and export query formation.

classes.name: EmployeeTest
classes.description: A test case class for the Employee module, covering instantiation, data validation, retrieval, query creation, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes a new Employee bean and configures the current user.

methods.name: testEmployee
methods.description: Tests creation and assertions on the Employee object and its class hierarchy.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Validates the get_summary_text() method with and without name being set.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Tests fill_in_additional_detail_fields() with empty and retrieved employee beans.

methods.name: testretrieve_employee_id
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee ID with a skipped test indicating a known bug.

methods.name: testverify_data
methods.description: Validates the verify_data() method returns true.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Checks that get_list_view_data() returns expected data structure.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Tests create_export_query() with different parameters and checks authorization restrictions.

methods.name: testcreate_new_list_query
methods.description: Contains commented-out/incomplete tests for create_new_list_query(), marked as incomplete.

methods.name: testhasCustomFields
methods.description: Checks whether the Employee bean has custom fields (expected false).

methods.name: testError
methods.description: Tests the display of error messages, including when no error and when a specific error string is set.
